comment_regular: Oblivion stBezierSpline::ClearCache behavior. Iterates the inline global map, destructs and FormHeap-frees every cached 0x5C spline, nulls value slots, destroys all tree nodes, and resets the existing sentinel/map to empty. RT 4.1 source corroborates ownership semantics; Oblivion differs by retaining an inline map rather than deleting a heap map pointer.
